out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED FOOD EMPLOYEE WASH FOOD THERMOMETER IN HANDWASHING SINK. OBSERVED SANITIZER BUCKET IN HANDWASHING SINK.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: SANITIZER BUCKET REMOVED FROM SINK. PIC RE-EDUCATED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: AT BREAKFAST BUFFET: OBSERVED TATER TOTS AT 122F, SCRAMBLED EGGS AT 133F, SAUSAGE AT 134F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: ITEMS WERE PLACED AT BUFFET AT 6AM. PIC AGREED TO MOVE FORWARD WITH TPHC INSTEAD OF LEAVING BELOW 135F. ALL FOOD LISTED ABOVE WILL BE DISPOSED OF AT 9AM AND WERE LABELED AS SUCH.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED YOGURT AT 48F IN THE ONE-DOOR UNDER COUNTER (CUSTOMER)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: YOGURT TO BE DISPOSED OF AT 9AM. DO NOT KEEP TCS FOOD IN THIS COOLER UNTIL IT OPERATES CORRECTLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: ONE-DOOR UNDER COUNTER (CUSTOMER) OBSERVED THE ABOVE COOLER TO BE AT 49F AND HOLDING YOGURT AT 48F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. THIS COOLER MAY NOT BE USED TO HOLD TCS FOODS UNTIL IT IS ADJUSTED TO HOLD FOOD AT 41F. DO NOT SET IT AT 41F. IT MUST BE SET AROUND 35F. HAVE THIS UNIT REPAIRED BY JUNE 19TH. BY THAT DATE, PLEASE SEND ME THE INVOICE AND PROOF IT IS COOLING AS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single- use items. OBSERVED EMPLOYEE CLOTHING AND PURSES IN THE DRY STORAGE ON TOP OF FOOD AND FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES USED AT THE HOTEL.
violations.corrective_action: Instruct employees to use the designated lockers and clothes hooks to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces. CDI: ITEMS RELOCATED. YOU MUST DESIGNATE AN AREA FOR EMPLOYEES TO STORE PERSONAL ITEMS. I RECOMMEND USING A BOTTOM SHELF IN THAT AREA.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events during the beginning of inspection
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided a copy of the Vomit and diarrhea clean up procedures to PIC, pic printed and posted the procedures

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device during the beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PIC was able to locate the thermometer later on during the inspection.
